chat.title: Setup assistant
chat.welcomeTitle: Before we start, a few quick concepts:
chat.welcomeMainAccount: 🏦 Main account — the bank account you use day to day, where most of your income comes in and most payments go out.
chat.welcomeReserveAccount: 💰 Reserve account — a separate account (ideally at another bank) that automatically sets aside a percentage of your income for taxes, emergencies, etc. It can never be the same as the main account.
chat.welcomeCreditCard: 💳 Credit card — tell us the bank, closing day and due day so the system can calculate each invoice correctly.
chat.emptyHint: Let's start: is this for personal use, business (PJ), or both? Feel free to also mention which bank accounts you use day to day.
chat.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
chat.summaryReadyHint: No need to send more messages now — click the button below to review and confirm.
chat.disclaimer: The assistant uses AI and can make mistakes. Nothing is created without your confirmation.
chat.disclaimerSummaryReady: Your proposal is ready above. Click "Review proposal" to continue — or write here if you want to adjust something first.
